results.title: Async fn and return-position impl Trait in traits
results.description: Rust 1.75 stabilizes async fn and return-position impl Trait in traits.
extra_snippets: dyn Trait is still unsupported; dynamic dispatch needs a crate such as async-trait.

results.title: Why is async in traits still painful?
results.description: The stabilized form covers static dispatch only, so anything object-safe still reaches for a crate.

data.title: Why is async in traits still painful?
data.question: I upgraded to 1.75 expecting dyn support and did not get it. What am I missing?
data.top_comment: Nothing — RPITIT gives you static dispatch. Object safety is a separate, unsolved problem.

extra_snippets: Send bounds are the other half: the returned future is not guaranteed Send.

results.title: async fn in trait: what changed in 1.75
results.description: A walk through the desugaring, and why the associated type cannot be named yet.

data.title: async fn in trait: what changed in 1.75
data.question: Can someone spell out the desugaring?
data.top_comment: It produces an anonymous associated type, which is why you cannot write the bound.
